## Insights (Blog)

- [All insights](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog): 9 guides on GEO, AI search, pricing, and growth systems
- [Paid Ads That Actually Compound: Our Forensic + GEO + AI Approach to 5.8× ROAS](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/paid-ads-that-compound): Most agencies run disconnected ad campaigns that burn budget on low-quality leads. We combine forensic audits, GEO, and AI automation to turn paid spend into consistent 5.8× ROAS and real pipeline growth.
- [AI Voice Agents for Local Businesses: Answer Every Call, Book Every Lead](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/ai-voice-agents-local-business): How AI voice agents help local businesses answer 100% of calls 24/7, book appointments automatically, and pay for the entire marketing retainer.
- [Case Study: How Meridian Health Partners Increased Bookings 312% in 90 Days](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/case-study-medical-practice-bookings): Meridian Health Partners grew new patient bookings 312%, cut CPA 47%, and hit ROI in 2.1 months with Aspen Malibu Marketing's Bespoke Service.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): The Complete 2026 Guide](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/generative-engine-optimization-guide): What GEO is, why it matters in 2026, and how Aspen Malibu Marketing helps brands get cited in AI search — not just ranked on Google.
- [How to Get Cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/get-cited-in-ai-search): Practical steps to earn AI search citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — from entity clarity to authority signals.
- [Growth Marketing Retainer Cost in 2026: Real Pricing, No Guesswork](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/growth-marketing-retainer-cost): What growth marketing retainers actually cost in 2026 — Aspen Malibu Marketing's tiered pricing for Growth Accelerator and Bespoke Service.
- [llms.txt, Schema.org, and OKF: A Technical Guide for AI Discoverability](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/llms-txt-schema-okf-guide): Technical walkthrough for llms.txt, schema.org markup, and Open Knowledge Framework — the files AI crawlers use to cite your brand.
- [Growth Accelerator vs. Bespoke Service: Which Engagement Is Right for You?](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/self-service-vs-managed-marketing): Compare Aspen Malibu Marketing's Growth Accelerator and Bespoke Service — self-service platform vs. fully managed revenue system, with real pricing.
- [What We Measure: ROAS, Retention, and the Metrics That Actually Matter](https://www.aspenmalibumarketing.com/blog/what-we-measure-roas-retention): Aspen Malibu Marketing tracks revenue metrics — 5.8× ROAS, 96% retention, real pipeline — and ignores vanity metrics that waste your budget.
